receipts.title: Goods received
receipts.subtitle: Receipts against purchase order {po}
receipts.needPo: Record receipts against a purchase order. Issue one first.
receipts.intro: Record what actually arrived, line by line. The first receipt with accepted units confirms delivery for this order and starts the statutory payment clock for micro and small suppliers. You can record several partial receipts.
receipts.progressCaption: Ordered, received, accepted and rejected quantities for purchase order {po}
receipts.cannotReceive: Goods cannot be received against this order right now.

form.receiverHint: Name of the person who checked the goods in.
form.lineSummary: Ordered {ordered} {unit}, already received {received}. You can still record up to {max}.
form.photos: Photos of the delivery or damage
form.photosHint: Optional. Up to 5 JPG or PNG files, 5 MB each.
form.deliveryNote: Recording a receipt with accepted units confirms delivery of this order. Receipts cannot be edited afterwards: record another receipt or raise a return to correct something.

match.title: Invoice match
match.subtitle: Purchase order {po}: order, goods received and invoice compared
match.intro: Each invoice is compared with the quantity you accepted and the price on the purchase order. Billing for more than you accepted, or at a different price, beyond your tolerance blocks marking the invoice paid unless you give a reason.
match.noReceipt: No goods receipt is recorded for this purchase order yet.
match.poLinesCaption: Ordered, received, accepted, rejected and billed quantities for purchase order {po}
match.tableCaption: Line by line match for invoice {number}
match.amountBasis: This invoice has no line detail, so its value is compared: {billed} billed against {accepted} accepted, at purchase order prices, before GST.
match.blockedMismatch: Marking this invoice paid is blocked until the difference is resolved, or you pay anyway with a reason.
match.blockedPending: Marking this invoice paid is blocked until a goods receipt is recorded, or you pay anyway with a reason.
match.sellerMismatch: The buyer's accepted quantity or the price differs from this invoice.
match.noInvoices: The seller has not recorded an invoice yet.
match.tolerancesIntro: A difference up to {qty}% in quantity and {price}% in price is accepted as within tolerance.
match.credited: Credit notes: {amount} reduce what you owe.
match.refundDue: You paid more than the invoice is now worth: the seller owes you {amount}.

settings.qtyHint: How much more than the accepted quantity an invoice may bill.
settings.priceHint: How far an invoice price may differ from the purchase order price.
settings.blockPending: Also block marking an invoice paid while no goods receipt is recorded.

pay.blockedMismatch: This invoice does not match the purchase order and the goods you accepted. Resolve it with the seller, or pay anyway and give a reason. The reason is saved and the seller can see that a mismatch exists.
pay.blockedPending: No goods receipt is recorded for this purchase order yet. Record the receipt, or pay anyway and give a reason.
pay.overrideHint: For example: advance agreed with the seller. 5 to 300 characters.

returns.title: Returns
returns.intro: Goods you asked to send back, and where each return stands.
returns.emptyDescription: You can request a return from any goods receipt, within the return window.

returnForm.title: Request a return
returnForm.subtitle: From goods receipt {number}
returnForm.intro: Choose how many units to send back. You can return units you rejected and units you accepted. Returns can be requested until {date}.
returnForm.windowClosed: The return window for this receipt closed on {date}.
returnForm.nothingLeft: Everything on this receipt is already in a return.
returnForm.noteHint: Do not include bank or personal details.

returnDetail.title: Return {number}
returnDetail.subtitle: From goods receipt {grn} on purchase order {po}
returnDetail.rejectedBy: The seller rejected this return. Their reason: {reason}
returnDetail.approvedNext: The seller approved the return. Send the goods back and record the tracking number below.
returnDetail.waiting: Waiting for the seller to approve or reject the return.
returnDetail.credited: Credit note {number} for {amount} dated {date} was recorded. It reduces what you owe on the invoice.
returnDetail.receivedBack: Received back by the seller on
returnDetail.cancelHint: You can withdraw it until the seller answers.
returnDetail.shipHint: Send the goods back, then enter the courier and the tracking or LR number so the seller can look out for them.

dispute.intro: A dispute goes to our resolution team with the order, the receipt and the return. Funds held in escrow stay frozen until it is decided.
dispute.text: What would you like us to know? (optional)
